description: This file defines a Connection class responsible for establishing and providing a singleton database connection using Doctrine DBAL within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. It includes methods for initializing the connection, retrieving it, and resetting it, along with setting up some database platform type mappings and logging system details.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A singleton class managing database connection initialization, retrieval, and reset, with configuration sourced from system state and logging capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the database connection using system state information, sets up type mappings, and logs system details.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Static method that returns the singleton database connection instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Static method that resets the singleton connection, setting it to null to allow reinitialization.
